summary: Business website for Sonu Textiles covering clothing and mehndi services, with bilingual (Hindi + English) support, product gallery, online ordering, mehndi design gallery, appointment booking, rates info, contact form, and About Us page.
imageRequirements:

- Hero banner with traditional Indian textile fabric texture, rich red and gold colors, elegant decorative border patterns (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
- Mehndi design illustration — intricate henna hand pattern in warm brown tones on cream background (mehndi-design-1.dim_400x400.png)

existing_features.title: Create a visually rich homepage for Sonu Textiles with a hero banner, business name, tagline in both Hindi and English, and navigation links to all sections (Clothing, Mehndi, About Us, Contact).

Implement a Clothing section displaying a product gallery with sample clothing items. Each item should show a name (Hindi + English), description, and price. Include an 'Order Now' button on each product that opens an order form.
Implement a Mehndi section with a design gallery (sample mehndi design images), a pricing/rates table in Hindi and English, and an appointment booking form.
Create an About Us page/section describing Sonu Textiles, its services (clothing and mehndi), and contact details. Content should be available in both Hindi and English.

Add a Contact Us section with a contact form collecting visitor name, phone number, email, and message. On submission, store the enquiry in the backend. Also display a phone number and location placeholder for the business.
Implement a language toggle button (Hindi / English) in the navigation bar that switches all UI text throughout the site between Hindi and English.

Apply a warm, festive, and elegant visual theme to the website — using rich jewel tones such as deep red, gold, and ivory — inspired by traditional Indian textile and mehndi aesthetics. Use decorative typography, consistent spacing, and an overall look that feels premium yet welcoming for a local Indian business.

new_feature_requests.summary: Clothing section with product gallery and online ordering
Mehndi section with design gallery, appointment booking, and rates info
Contact form and About Us page
Bilingual support (Hindi and English) throughout the website
